objective: Robustecer la autenticacion del push del executor. Mantener primero el credential.helper local canonico; si el push falla por autenticacion, reintentar una sola vez con helpers Git limpiados para permitir el GIT_ASKPASS heredado del runtime. No exponer secretos, no hardcodear tokens y no tocar Produccion.

actions.old:
push = run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "credential.helper=",
            "-c",
            f"credential.helper={credential_helper}",
            "push",
            REMOTE,
            f"{head}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}",
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        env_extra={"EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH": "1"},
    )
    if push.returncode != 0:
        return False, f"development_push_failed:{push.stdout[-1000:]}"
actions.new:
push_args = [
        "git",
        "-c",
        "credential.helper=",
        "-c",
        f"credential.helper={credential_helper}",
        "push",
        REMOTE,
        f"{head}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}",
    ]
    push = run(
        push_args,
        cwd=ROOT,
        env_extra={"EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH": "1"},
    )
    if push.returncode != 0 and (
        "could not read Username" in push.stdout
        or "Authentication failed" in push.stdout
        or "credential" in push.stdout.lower()
    ):
        push = run(
            [
                "git",
                "-c",
                "credential.helper=",
                "push",
                REMOTE,
                f"{head}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}",
            ],
            cwd=ROOT,
            env_extra={"EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH": "1"},
        )
    if push.returncode != 0:
        return False, f"development_push_failed:{push.stdout[-1000:]}"
